definitions: Nothing is entirely free; there is always a cost, even if not immediately apparent.
Every benefit or advantage has an associated cost or drawback.
examples: Don't expect to get something for nothing; there is no such thing as a free lunch.
While the initial offer seems great, remember there is no such thing as a free lunch.
lemma: there is no such thing as a free lunch
synonyms: you get what you pay for
source: there is no such thing as a free lunch
